verdict.rationale: Metorial's SDK docs say the platform runs OAuth so users can authorize access to downstream services like Slack, GitHub and Google Calendar. Each environment keeps its own authentication configs, and each user connects their own apps. Nothing in the pack documents how the resulting credentials are stored or encrypted, or that tokens refresh automatically. Missing for 10: documented encrypted credential vaulting, automatic token refresh, independent or hands-on corroboration of the OAuth flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the platform run OAuth flows for downstream tools and vault the resulting credentials encrypted, with automatic token refresh

citations.quote: OAuth lets your users authorize access to their accounts on services like Slack, GitHub, Google Calendar, and more.
each user connects their own apps and keeps the permissions they should have.
Each environment has its own provider deployments, API keys, authentication configs, and logs
